subject: Operations
title: Strategy Meets Operations
description: A micro-lesson that makes Strategy Meets Operations usable.

hook.text: A brilliant product strategy fails because the factory can't deliver on time. Strategy without operations is a wish.

buildup.text: Operations strategy connects what a company promises to customers with how it actually delivers those promises.

discovery.text: It defines what capabilities operations must build: speed, quality, flexibility, or cost leadership.

twist.text: Most companies write a business strategy but never translate it into operational choices. The gap causes failure.

climax.text: When operations strategy aligns with business strategy, execution becomes the competitive advantage.

punchline.text: Strategy says what to win. Operations says how.
